name: pulse
description: Laravel Pulse: the monitoring dashboard at /pulse (administrators and PULSE_VIEWERS), its migration, the pulse:check worker in the production image, a Filament navigation item, and the /pulse location in the NGINX site of the CMS monorepo root.
steps: Backend (every Laravel variant): php artisan migrate (the production container runs it at start where RUN_MIGRATIONS=true)

Backend: set PULSE_VIEWERS in .env and in the stack's environment (emails that may open /pulse besides the administrators), and name it in the pull request's deploy notes; PULSE_ENABLED=false switches the recorders off
Backend: rebuild the release image, it runs the new Supervisor program `laravel-pulse` (php artisan pulse:check) and the new Composer package
Backend, `laravel-cms` served under /admin of the site's domain (CMS_ADMIN_PATH_MODE=true): set PULSE_PATH=admin/pulse, the session cookie only reaches /admin
Site (astro-cms): reload NGINX with the new /pulse location (copy it from docker/nginx.example to the server)
